profile.headline: DevSecOps Leader | Champion of Collaboration, Security & Innovation | Building High‑Trust, High‑Impact Engineering Teams
profile.summary:
What do I bring to the table? I am a versatile IT professional with expertise in networking, development, and systems administration. Armed with deep technical knowledge and sharp analytical skills, I excel at solving complex business  business and technical challenges; driving innovation. I take pride in fostering collaboration across globally distributed teams and creating environments that encourage teamwork and creativity. Passionate about continuous learning, I stay ahead of industry trends and bring fresh insights into every project. My work is guided by honesty, loyalty, and an unwavering commitment to excellence.

A career rooted in Financial Technologies With 18 years of experience at FIS, I have played a pivotal role in advancing Mobile and Online Banking solutions within the e-Payments Division. My journey began in Online Banking Quality Assurance as a Systems Administrator and has since spanned roles such as Mobile Banking QA Leader, Senior Programmer Analyst, and Software/DevSecOps Engineer. This diverse career progression reflects my adaptability and passion for tackling new challenges.

My Current Focus: DevSecOps 

As a DevSecOps professional, my current work revolves around fostering a culture of security and efficiency within the CI/CD lifecycle. By aligning Service Delivery and Development teams, I blend administrative and development expertise to deliver impactful solutions. I have implemented CI/CD pipelines that streamline processes and boost operational efficiency, leveraging modern tools and technologies to stay at the forefront of innovation. In my current role, I focus on building pipelines that shift left, empowering development teams to refine their craft and delivery teams to maximize application performance.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer Senior, Digital One
positions.description:
As a senior member of the Digital One Development team, I championed CI/CD pipeline development, system architecture, and team growth. I mentored junior developers, maintained thorough documentation, and collaborated with leadership to shape critical CI/CD lifecycle decisions. I managed the build and deployment of various digital banking applications.
Recently, I led the transformation toward Cloud Native Applications and advanced DevSecOps practices, leveraging GitHub Actions, Amazon Lambda, EKS, Kong, and Terraform. I also led teams towards decoupling releases from deployments using LaunchDarkly’s feature flagging. Additionally, I integrated BitRise for mobile banking applications, enhancing automation and scalability.
At FIS, I drive innovation in an ever-evolving landscape, ensuring cutting-edge solutions in digital banking technology.

Key Accomplishments:

Played a pivotal role in building the development CI/CD pipeline for the Digital One Flex Banking product, enabling the team to meet a tight 6-month deadline from architecture to production.

Spearheaded the migration and upgrade from OpenShift 3.x to 4.x, training team members to replicate the process for supported CI/CD pipeline applications.

Led the transition from Helm 2.x to 3.x, implementing new features, resolving chart validation issues, and optimizing Helm repositories to streamline templates and workflows.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst, Specialist, Digital One
positions.description:
Programmer Analyst, Specialist, Digital One As a senior member of the Digital One Service Delivery team, I managed the creation and maintenance of CD pipelines, systems architecture, and monitoring, while mentoring junior team members and ensuring thorough documentation. I collaborated with leadership to drive decisions around operations, security, networking, and performance for the Digital One Online Banking Suite.

Key Accomplishments:

Special Assignment: Enabled the development and integration of the Personetics AI Powered Engagement Builder. Successfully saw the project through to production by collaborating with various stakeholders across multiple disciplines to build the necessary infrastructure and operational processes.

Developed a Jenkins workflow to automate legacy Bash script tasks, streamlining the deployment of CSS sheets to OpenShift Kubernetes and enabling broader team participation in automation processes.

Designed and implemented support for legacy batch functions using VM architecture, Control-M tools, and newly developed Bash scripts to modernize workflows.

Built an enterprise-compliant development CI/CD pipeline (S2I) using Jenkins, Helm Charts, and FIS-specific image repositories to automate deployments for the Service Delivery team.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst, Senior, Online Banking
positions.description:
Programmer Analyst, Senior, Online Banking Provided full support for the Production OLB-Online Banking application, ensuring maximum uptime through team-focused support and rapid issue resolution. Contributed to major infrastructure projects and played a leadership role in operational enhancements.

Key Accomplishments:

Led the design of infrastructure upgrades during a 12-month data center move in 2017, which included an OS upgrade and significant technology improvements.

Improved monitoring capabilities by upgrading local systems with PowerShell and implementing enterprise-wide monitors.

Enhanced disaster recovery models to strengthen system resilience and reduce downtime.

Acted as the primary contact for Microsoft support, managing in-depth troubleshooting for complex OS issues.

positions.description: Deliver technical support and services to Rosen Hotels & Resorts guests, conference center clients, and employees.

positions.title: Print Room Operator
positions.description:
I Supported financial operations by maintaining and troubleshooting IBM Laser and Impact Printers, ensuring accurate printing of reports and customer statements. Communicated technical issues effectively with IBM technicians and contributed to disaster recovery tests and system upgrades.

Other Roles Held: Proof Operator, Data Entry Specialist, Exception Handling Specialist, Machine Operator, and Statement Rendering Specialist.

projects.title: Sci-Fi UI Live Wallpaper-Android (Retired)
projects.description:
This project was set to prove my programming abilities and it enables Android OS device owners to have a wallpaper of their favorite Science Fiction User Interfaces.  Highlights of this project are:
1) Easy to create\update\add themes via XML File.
2) Light weight application file(s) as most images are rendered.
3) Images that are rendered can be animated.
4) Battery Conscious using timeouts and loading techniques.
5) Theme overrides and settings.
6) Hardware detection and reporting. i.e. Battery and Battery Level.
